subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: After the ordering bug is fixed, should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue, or choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same model-routing callback contract with different formats, and the final callback shape should be an intentional owner decision before merge.

options.title: Use this PR after ordering fix
options.body: Land this branch as canonical once it uses one model ordering contract across render and resolve paths, preserving name-based callbacks except where Telegram's limit requires the index fallback.

options.title: Choose the sibling candidate
options.body: Pick https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 if maintainers prefer that broader callback contract, then pause or close this PR after preserving useful proof/context.

options.title: Hold both for owner selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback format, accepting another contributor round trip.

recommendation.title: Use this PR after ordering fix
recommendation.body: Land this branch as canonical once it uses one model ordering contract across render and resolve paths, preserving name-based callbacks except where Telegram's limit requires the index fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest callback-data and Telegram model-button history among the likely owners.
